1 General See chart AD 2.PVT-EBMO-VAC.01 .
Position reporting is compulsory when joining, leaving and within the aerodrome traffic circuit.
2 Inbound Traffic Start listening out on Moorsele Radio on 120.505 MHZ at least 10 NM out and report 5 NM inbound reporting point DADDI (505121.74N 0030522.97E) or TURBI (505343.72N 0031035.61E) at 1 500 FT AMSL . If no parachute activity is confirmed, join the circuit and proceed for landing. When parachutes are in the air or about to be dropped, hold at your reporting point until signal is transmitted “all parachutes on the ground”, then proceed to join the circuit at 1 000 FT AGL .
After landing, taxi to the aircraft parking area in front of the Clubhouse (C), do not park in the parachute landing area!
3 Outbound Traffic No engine shall be started or running and no aircraft shall commence taxi when parachutes are in the air or about to be dropped. Therefore listen out Moorsele radio. When all parachutes are on the ground taxi to holding point and make sure you depart before the next group of parachutes will be dropped. After departure, leave the ATZ right away without coming overhead. When proceeding to the East or South, contact Kortrijk Info on 120.250 MHZ to cross the RMZ / TMZ .
4 Aerodrome Traffic Circuits Circuit height: 1000 FT AGL .
RWY 04: Left-hand circuit.
RWY 22: Right-hand circuit.
